buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and Conditions for Procurement and Installation of Gym Equipment 1. Installation at Own Cost: The successful bidder shall supply, transport, unload, assemble and install a ll the supplied gym equipment at Gram Panchayat Sitanagar, at their own cost. No additional charges shall be payable by the Gram Panchayat for transportation, labour, installation or commissioning. 2. Local Establishment: The bidder must have a registered office, shop or business establishment situat ed within the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. 3. Shop Registration Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Shop and Establishment Registration C ertificate or other applicable business registration certificate issued by the competent authority in the And aman & Nicobar Islands along with the bid. 4. Document Verification: The Gram Panchayat reserves the right to verify the submitted documents an d reject any bid found to be false, misleading or incomplete. 5. Quality of Equipment: All gym equipment supplied must be brand new, unused and of good quality, c onforming to the specifications mentioned in the bid. 6. Warranty: The bidder shall provide a manufacturer's warranty for the supplied gym equipment as speci fied in the bid. 7. Inspection and Acceptance: Payment shall be released only after satisfactory supply, installation, ins pection and acceptance of the equipment by the competent authority of Gram Panchayat Sitanagar. 8. Completion of Work: The successful bidder shall complete the supply and installation within the stipul ated period mentioned in the work order. 9. Responsibility for Damage: The bidder shall be responsible for any damage caused to the Building or its premises during transportation, unloading, installation or commissioning. 10. Right to Reject: The Gram Panchayat reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids without assigning any reason, as per applicable procurement rules.
